text.text_excerpt: 4.5 stars I do love Nola Snow. The owners, Rudy & MiMi, are all about New Orleans. The staff is always friendly and if they aren't too busy, they'll answer questions about nearly every single flavor on the menu if you are having a hard time deciding on which flavor to get. Today, we opted to get 2 kiddie sizes so that we could try 2 different flavors (all in the interests of Yelping about it). The first flavor was yellow cake batter and I ain't kidding when I tell you that if you close your eyes and use your imagination, you'd swear you were a kid again and licking the cake batter from your momma's spatula. Well, almost! The 2nd flavor we ordered was cream ice cream. Since they were nearl...

This is my go to snowball stand and I only have good things to say about it. They offer lots of great flavors - chocolate with sweetened condensed milk is my favorite, and the prices are very reasonable. The ice is soft, and they don't skimp on the syrup. Their soft serve ice cream is pretty good too, and it's even better stuffed in a snowball.

That fine fine snowball ice and a decent amount of flavors. Operates during the warm months. Enjoyed a roat beer float once. The soft serve isn't my favorite though because it's not the creamiest out there. I like that this place is in walking distance from my house. They gave out free snowballs at the Night Out Against Crime which was cool. I met the owner during the event, and he noted that he had been making snowballs for a lifetime. The flavors were intense. I look forward to another root beer float in the future.
